description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans, derived on
                read: the country calling code, a space, then the national digits
                grouped in threes separated by spaces (e.g. '+61412345678'
                becomes '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field keeps the
                unformatted E.164 value.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'. REGION is the region code derived from
                the postcode (falling back to the city). FY is the two-digit
                fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. HASH8
                is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized telephone followed by lastName. CHK is a single Luhn
                check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
                When this base id collides with an existing owner's, '-<n>' is
                appended with the smallest n of 2 or more that makes it unique.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household - the
                same last name and postcode. Deterministically derived as the
                first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                'normalizedLastName|postcode', so owners with the same last name
                and postcode automatically receive the same value. Absent when the
                owner has no postcode.
              type: string
              example: '8F14E45FCEEA'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the full lower-case SHA-256 hex
                digest over
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>' (the
                email segment is empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates
                exactly when their whole identity keys are equal; a create request
                whose identity key matches an existing owner's is rejected with
                409.
              type: string
              example: '75081e2648c06081f40036cec119d35b9232ff73ab34b2d0fd75c473a8ef4fa0'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on
                create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the FY
                segment of the memberId (the two-digit fiscal year of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate). The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July and is labelled by the calendar year in which it starts,
                so a registrationDate on or after 1 July falls in that year's
                fiscal year and one before 1 July falls in the previous year's
                (e.g. a registrationDate of 2026-09-06 yields 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived from the owner's factors.
                Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when the
                owner's namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more,
                plus 3 when tenure exceeds one fiscal year (i.e. the number of
                elapsed fiscal years since registration is more than 1).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and
                4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived on read as the REGION segment of the
                memberId (the region code baked into the
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' identity). 'UNKNOWN' when neither the
                postcode nor the city resolves to a known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived on read from the 'locality'
                region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW ->
                Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD ->
                Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region does not resolve to a
                known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, derived on read and formatted
                '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or
                more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is
                a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                A soft warning flag, derived on read: true when more than 80
                owners have been created (by registrationDate) on the same day
